title: Black bean tortilla soup
skill: A soup from boxed broth at a simmer

notes.text: Use the stockpot, and bring it to a boil a little longer.

move.title: Boil, then simmer
move.body: Tortilla soup is a Mexican-American favorite: a spiced tomato broth full of beans and corn, topped with crunchy tortilla chips and avocado. Today you'll bring the pot to a boil, turn it down to a gentle simmer, and hold it there.

why.title: Boil vs. simmer
why.body: A boil has big bubbles rolling all over. A simmer has small bubbles that just break the top. Soup cooks best at a simmer.

why.title: Spices in the oil
why.body: Spices stirred in hot oil for 30 seconds smell stronger and taste deeper.

why.title: Rinse the beans
why.body: The thick liquid in the can is salty and cloudy. Rinsing it off keeps the soup clear.

why.title: Toppings last
why.body: Chips go soggy in the pot. Add them to each bowl just before eating.

wrong.fix: Turn the heat down until only small bubbles show.
Squeeze in lime juice and add a pinch of salt.
Add them right before you eat next time.

quiz.q: What does a simmer look like?
choices: Small bubbles just breaking the top
quiz.explain: A boil is big and rolling.

choices: To wash off the salty, cloudy liquid

quiz.q: When do the chips go in?
choices: On each bowl, right before eating
quiz.explain: They go soggy in the pot.

steps.text: Open the cans of beans and tomatoes with the can opener.
steps.tip: The lid edges are sharp. Don't touch them.

steps.text: Pour the beans into the colander. Rinse them under cold water.
steps.look: No foam left on the beans.

steps.text: Measure the cumin and chili powder into the small bowl.
Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Add the onion and stir now and then.
Stir in the garlic and spices for 30 seconds.
steps.tip: Have the broth ready to pour.

steps.text: Pour in the broth and tomatoes. Add the beans, corn, and salt.
steps.look: A full pot of red soup.

steps.text: Turn the heat to high and bring it to a boil.
Turn the heat down to low. Simmer with the lid off, stirring now and then.
steps.look: Small bubbles just breaking the top.

steps.text: If you're using chicken, pull 2 cups into bite-size pieces. Stir them into the pot.
steps.tip: Keep the rest in the fridge.

steps.text: Push the thermometer into the soup's middle. It should read 165°F.
An adult cuts the avocado in half and takes out the pit. Scoop and dice it.
Turn off the stove. Squeeze the lime into the soup and taste. Add salt if needed.
Ladle the soup into bowls. Top each with chips, avocado, cilantro, and cheese.
steps.look: Crunchy chips on top of red soup.
